scope: H2 private-image preparation and streaming source plus ordinary synthetic/native-file/Job tests; no operational activation.
head: 454e41aa021c2b8b8b48531f2cb67838ecaa7dab

patch.construction: sorted paths; tracked git diff --binary HEAD, new files git header/mode plus difflib unified diff from /dev/null; all authored source LF

resolved_findings.problem: Distinct native parent. and ordinary parent caused the initial intent to be written outside the held parent.
resolved_findings.resolution: Root components refuse normalized aliases/devices/control/malformed Unicode before opens; reservation and image creation now use the held parent handle.

resolved_findings.problem: Actual 8.3 alias bypassed lexical separation and allowed intent creation inside input.
resolved_findings.resolution: Held normalized NT names and native IDs enforce conservative overlap refusal; equal/nested real short aliases refuse before reservation. Literal drive mapping is checked separately and cannot redirect relative creation.

independent_verification.original_attack_replays: Both retained attacks refuse; original fixture bytes unchanged.

assurance: Immutable exact ImagePlan admits finite entry/path/UTF16/file/total/time budgets and a declared entrypoint; bytes are preparation data until later loader qualification.
Separate streaming preserves the original 16MiB H1 write limit and candidate budgets; consumed sinks refuse reuse after chunk/read/digest/flush/deadline failure.
Source reads use no-reparse relative handles with denied write/delete sharing and check exact object ID, regular single-link size and consumed bytes.
The create-only journal uses the held parent and transfers its handle exactly once to a non-inheritable CRT descriptor; both adoption failures close handles and retain the reserved name.

Created image roots and their seal operations remain relative to the held parent. Grants use the exact internal plan package SID after all byte copies and sealing; no worker dispatch API consumes this helper.

Case-fold canonical ancestry comparisons intentionally refuse ambiguous case-sensitive siblings. Identity remains separately checked. Explicit volume-GUID/UNC input paths refuse; admitted drive aliases are compared in the held normalized NT namespace.
Initial durable intent makes interrupted/uncertain generations non-replayable. Failure handling retains objects and closes leases; no cleanup/adoption path was added.
limits: Native image DACL grants, actual tool copies, PE/library dependency closure and isolated Python/Git/Codex loading remain unqualified.
Protected controller/source/store descriptors and current guard must be established separately.
Synchronous kernel calls require a qualified outer owned process for hard wall-clock enforcement; source checks alone cannot interrupt stalled I/O.
PreparedImage observations do not establish an atomic global namespace lease or qualify future worker launch paths.
No profile, package grant, real drive mapping change, real tool copy, model network or AppContainer launch in this review.

official_api_references.supports: Relative RootDirectory creation binds the directory handle.
Normalized VOLUME_NAME_NT names originate from the held object, with bounded returned length.
CRT descriptor adopts the native handle and closes it through the descriptor/file owner.
